dossier_meta.statement_text: For each positive integer $r$, the bound $$h(n, k, W_{2r+1}) \leq c_r \frac{n^2}{k^{2 - 1/(r+1)}}$$ is tight up to the constant factor $c_r$ depending on $r$.
dossier_meta.context_text: Theorem 1.5 gives the upper bound $h(n,k,W_{2r+1}) \leq c_r n^2/k^{2-1/(r+1)}$ for odd wheels when $n \geq k \geq 2$. The authors conjecture this is tight, by analogy with their matching lower bounds in the odd-cycle case.
